text.p: Matches scheduled this weekend in the French first division (standings in parentheses, all kick-off times GMT):
Nantes (6) v Lille (15) Midfielder Claude Makelele is doubtful for Nantes, unbeaten in 22 league matches. Lille have defender Frederic Dindeleux, sent off against Nancy last weekend, suspended.

Monaco (1) v Bastia (5) Leaders Monaco turn attention back to league after booking UEFA Cup semifinal berth confident they can go one better after 0-0 draw at Bastia in October. The Corsicans will be without midfielder Lubomir Moravcik, still under suspension after red card at Nantes two weeks ago.

Lyon (9) v Le Havre (13) France striker Florian Maurice, who returned from six-month injury lay-off last weekend, is doubtful for Lyon with groin strain. Le Havre are unbeaten in three games including 1-0 victory over Paris St Germain last weekend.

Lens (17) v Auxerre (7) Playing at Le Havre because of one-match ban on Lens stadium, champions Auxerre will look for win in only competition left them after European Cup elimination and hoping to secure place in Europe again next season.

Nancy (19) v Bordeaux (4) Relegation looms ever larger for Nancy who have striker Tony Cascarino and Nigerian midfielder Wilson Oruma out with injury and four others, including Paris St Germain-bound defender Eric Rabesandratana, doubtful. League Cup finalists Bordeaux, out to avenge 1-0 home defeat by Nancy in October, have defender Bernard Lambourde suspended.

Cannes (16) v Rennes (14) Goalkeeper Francois Lemasson has been dropped by Cannes after row with training staff and is replaced by Sebastien Renaud. Rennes, unbeaten at home until a month ago, have picked up only two points in six leagues games this year and top scorer Stephane Guivarc'h has not found net since December.

Guingamp (11) v Strasbourg (3) Strasbourg, unbeaten in four games, have striker Pascal Nouma and midfielder Stephane Collet suspended. Guingamp are unbeaten at home this year including 3-1 home win over Marseille last weekend.

Montpellier (12) v Nice (20) Nice travel without suspended defender Youssef Salimi and with minds on French Cup quarter-final at fourth division Clermont following weekend. Montpellier have climbed out of relegation zone with eight-match unbeaten run.

PSG can relaunch title challenge, which took dent in 1-0 defeat at Le Havre last weekend, after rediscovering best form in 3-0 win at AEK Athens in European Cup Winners' Cup on Thursday. Metz, unbeaten in three games, are without injured forwards Amara Traore of Senegal and France's Robert Pires.

Caen (18) v Marseille (10) Marseille, yet to win away this season and looking to end run of three successive defeats, welcome back striker Xavier Gravelaine after suspension. Caen, who have defender William Gallas suspended, will be looking to repeat shock 1-0 win at Marseille's Velodrome stadium in October.
